preexisting_specification.requirement: compare v2 against frozen v1, local-only, geographic maximin, and same-pool random in the untouched confirmation cohort
preexisting_specification.note: This companion restores the already-written issue-57 comparator requirement without changing the separately frozen corrected-GRTS-v2 primary gate.

scientific_zero_alignment.rule: If the frozen fresh primary pair artifact marks a fold explicit_scientific_zero, all companion methods receive the same zero fold estimand; no missing artifact is converted to zero.
scientific_zero_alignment.reason: For training-only candidate pools below Top-5 the frozen primary protocol defines the declared zero estimand. This companion must not alter primary eligibility after cohort freeze.

outcome_separation: For complete folds, every companion selection is computed from candidate_pool_pre_outcome.csv before held_out_occurrences.csv is opened for scoring.

inference.required_v2_minus_frozen_v1_gate: 192/192 verified pair artifacts AND mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
inference.other_comparators: report pair-level inference descriptively; they do not replace the separately frozen corrected-GRTS-v2 primary gate

fitted_sdm_note: The original issue requested fitted-SDM Top-5 when applicable. The fresh primary artifacts do not freeze the training-state fitted-SDM object, so no post hoc surrogate will be mislabeled as fitted SDM; the existing separate fitted-SDM decision benchmark remains the supported SDM contrast.
